description: This file defines the MenuItemAPI class for the OrangeHRM mobile plugin, responsible for providing menu items data for the mobile application through an API endpoint. It manages menu configurations based on user roles and module statuses, returning JSON responses that include menu items and related metadata.

classes.name: MenuItemAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class that provides mobile menu items based on user role and active modules, supporting role-specific and module-specific menu configuration.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to list mobile menu items, configuring menu entries based on user role, supervisor status, and enabled modules, and returning structured JSON data with menu items and metadata.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the GET request, excluding the 'id' parameter.
